Current model · S1 / S2 / S3

One process. Three energy settings.

ATT reacts pressed Sargassum with alkali to produce hydrogen-containing gas, recover sodium and form calcium carbonate. The same core flowsheet is paired with land-based utilities, marine engine heat or hypothetical industrial heat.

Mass and elemental balances

System balances include modeled air and water. A mathematically closed balance does not validate physical species identities. Unit-stream rows include internal recycle streams and must not be summed as independent system outputs.

All unit stream compositions

Unresolved Organic Matter and Carbon Fate

ResidueCH (CH₀.₅) and ResidueCHO (CH₀.₅O₂) are balancing components created in U2. RS1 sends the remaining material to att_residue_untracked; its simulator phase label is not evidence of a real disposal pathway. The model assigns no cost, treatment burden or storage credit to it.

The unresolved mass affects potential treatment costs, wastewater COD, methane emissions and the assumed thermochemical properties that determine reactor heat. Required measurements include matched DAF gas yields, dissolved organic carbon and COD, solid and liquid composition, char yield, degradation and methane potential.

Carbon boundary ledger and pseudo-component trace

Sodium and calcium cycles

The reactor’s gross NaOH dose is not the same as fresh makeup. The 100% assumed NaOH-to-carbonate conversion, 88% causticization and 95% whole-liquor recycle are model assumptions; the latter is an interpretation of an incompletely specified experimental recovery.

Techno-economic analysis

Annual treatment economics

Capital charge is FCI × capital recovery factor at the configured IRR and lifetime. Working capital, tax, debt and startup are excluded from this simple screening cost. H₂ MSP remains a separate DCF result.

S1 operating cost ledger

S1 installed equipment and scenario increments

Life-cycle assessment · GWP100

Baseline net GWP includes storage of feed-derived carbon in carbonate cakes and char. Sold CaCO₃ permanence and end use are not established. No CaCO₃ substitution or avoided beach decomposition credit is added. HCl and oxalic acid manufacture use provisional source-based factors; treatment of unresolved organics remains missing.

Functional-unit comparisons

The incoming feed is wet presscake, not fresh harvested seaweed or dry ash-free material. Results retain the original coproduct convention. Every scenario uses the same feed-boundary definition.

Assumptions and sources

The searchable register is extracted from the active configuration files at report generation. Entries without units or literature references in the source are labeled accordingly; inclusion is not verification.
